data.description: Evergreens at Damac Hills 2: Tranquil Living with Modern Flair
data.long_description:
Evergreens at Damac Hills 2 introduces a refreshing take on modern living, offering 1 and 2-bedroom apartments within a serene environment crafted by Damac Properties. This G+7 tower boasts stunning views of lush parklands, creating a peaceful retreat in the heart of Dubai. With its strategic location near Al Qudra Road, residents enjoy seamless access to the city’s key destinations. The development enhances everyday life with water-themed attractions like Malibu Beach and a wave surfing simulator, offering a perfect balance of relaxation and recreation.

The sleek white facade, blending effortlessly with its natural surroundings, embodies simplicity and elegance. Expansive balconies offer uninterrupted views, capturing both the warmth of sunrise and the calm of sunset. This space extends your living experience into nature, providing a harmonious backdrop for a life of comfort and indulgence.
